caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden block with six carved designs on its surface. The block is light brown in color with visible wood grain. The carvings include: in the top row, from left to right, a diamond-shaped pattern with a smaller diamond and dot motif in the center and a beaded edge, a flower with multiple petals radiating from a central core, and another flower with rounded petals and a stippled center. In the bottom row, from left to right, there is a carving of a three-part leaf with a central bud, a motif resembling a vase or pot with a geometric pattern and a floral garnish, and a branching design of two flowers with detailed petals and two large leaves extending from the stem. The overall arrangement is two rows of three carvings each, evenly spaced upon the flat wooden surface. At the bottom right, the name "FRITZ BOEHMER" is written in black uppercase letters.
title: Pa. German Springerle Board
